title: OLS Regression
sub: All variables stationary in levels. U.S. stock returns and the economy, monthly, 1985–2019

title: VAR in First Differences
sub: All variables I(1), no cointegration. U.S. stock prices and industrial production, monthly, 1985–2019

title: Vector Error-Correction Model
sub: All variables I(1), cointegrated. U.S. 10-year and 1-year Treasury yields, quarterly, 1960–2019

title: ARDL Bounds-Testing Model
sub: A mix of I(0) and I(1) variables. U.S. 10-year Treasury yield, inflation, GDP growth and unemployment, quarterly, 1960–2019

title: Nonlinear ARDL (NARDL)
sub: I(0) and I(1) variables, with asymmetric effects. U.S. Baa corporate bond yield and federal funds rate, monthly, 1985–2019

title: 2SLS and GMM
sub: Endogenous regressors that need instruments. U.S. policy rule, quarterly, 1979–2007; UK firm employment panel, 1976–1984

title: Local Projections (Impulse Responses)
sub: The dynamic response to a shock, h periods ahead. U.S. credit spread and industrial production, monthly, 1985–2019

title: Structural VAR
sub: Shocks identified by Cholesky, long-run or proxy restrictions. U.S. output and unemployment, quarterly

title: Structural Breaks (Bai–Perron)
sub: Estimate how many breaks and when, with confidence intervals. U.S. inflation, quarterly

title: Threshold Regression (TAR / SETAR)
sub: Abrupt regime changes at an estimated level, with a bootstrap test. U.S. inflation, quarterly

title: Smooth-Transition Regression (LSTAR / ESTAR)
sub: Coefficients that move gradually with a state variable. U.S. monetary policy rule, quarterly

title: ARIMA and Seasonal ARIMA (SARIMA)
sub: One series, and the goal is to describe its dynamics or forecast it. U.S. monthly PCE inflation (annualised), 1985–2019
